class.name: JRPGLoopCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: runs its commands again and again until Break Loop.
class.description: Runs [member body] again and again until a [JRPGBreakLoopCommand] inside it leaves the loop (or [JRPGExitEventCommand] ends the event, or a [JRPGJumpToLabelCommand] goes out of it); the event then goes on after the loop. Loops nest. A loop that never waits is spread over simulation steps, with a warning, so it never freezes the game. Authority: server.
